(async () => { for (let i=0;i<100;++i) { if (window.__FLAGGLE_DB__) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); } const db = window.__FLAGGLE_DB__; if (!db) return false; await db.classic.add({ win: true, guesses: 2 }); await db.classic.add({ win: false, guesses: 6 }); return true; })()

asserts.expr: (() => { const labs = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === 'Avg. Guesses'); if (!labs.length) return null; const lab = labs[0]; const wrap = lab.parentElement; if (!wrap) return null; return wrap.textContent.replace('Avg. Guesses', '').trim(); })()

(() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-testid="export-textarea"]'); if (!t || !t.value.startsWith('FLAGGLE_')) return false; try { return atob(t.value.slice(8)).split('|').length === 5; } catch(e) { return false; } })()
